description: This line plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers of a neural network model, comparing four distinct output pathways: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The horizontal axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, indicating the layer index. The vertical axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 on a linear scale. The plot displays four lines: the attn_output is shown as a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting near zero, rising sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then dropping to near zero by layer 10 before rising again to about 200 at layer 22; the attn_residual is an orange dotted line with circular markers, beginning near zero, peaking at approximately 1500 at layer 5, remaining relatively constant until layer 15, then dropping to around 600 at layer 22; the ffn_output is a green dashed line with triangular markers, starting near zero, rising steeply to about 1200 at layer 5, then falling to near zero by layer 10 before increasing again to approximately 1200 at layer 22; and the ffn_residual is a red solid line with circular markers, beginning near zero, rising to approximately 1500 at layer 5, remaining nearly constant until layer 15, then declining to about 600 at layer 22.
